tasks.instructions: A region is ready only if both API and storage are generally available in that same region. No cross-region fallback is allowed. Synthesize the independent availability reports. Return rollout as one of us_only, eu_only, both, neither.

sources.text: API generally available regions: US, EU.
Storage generally available regions: US. EU storage is preview only.
A launch requires API and storage generally available in the same region. Preview does not qualify. No cross-region fallback.

tasks.instructions: Determine the applicable active-data retention for Meridian as of 2026-09-30. Signed account overrides take precedence over tier defaults, which take precedence over standard defaults. Marketing material is not authoritative. Apply the independent approval rule to the resulting duration. If backup retention is not specified, answer null with unit unknown and no citations.

sources.text: Standard active-data retention: 30 [days]. Enterprise active-data retention: 90 [days].
Signed Meridian account override effective 2026-09-01: active-data retention: 45 [days]. Account overrides supersede tier defaults.
Any applicable active-data retention greater than 30 days requires approval, including account overrides.
Marketing draft: all enterprise customers get 120 days. This is not a signed policy.
